summary: Full-width message for page-level or system communications (maintenance, announcements).
whenToUse: Information that concerns the entire application.
whenNotToUse: Messages about a section: use Alert.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral uses the brand surface for announcements.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button; persist the preference yourself if needed.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stays at the top while scrolling.

keyboard.action: Reaches the action and the close button.

accessibility: Not a live region: for dynamic messages use Toast or a live Alert.
The tone is also conveyed via hidden text.
responsive: Centered content that wraps on mobile.
commonMistakes: Stacking multiple banners: merge the messages or prioritize them.

examples.name: ToneAndAction
examples.title: Controlled tone, action and dismissal
examples.description: The tone is chosen with a RadioGroup; the action updates a counter and dismissing hides the banner.

examples.name: StickyInScrollArea
examples.title: Sticky banner in a scrolling container
examples.description: With sticky, the banner stays at the top of the ScrollArea while scrolling.
